title: 第五章愤怒的李长寿第六章高人形象真实之眼的新用法
slug: 多子多福照顾女帝一天修为涨一万
lines: “放肆，连我张家的人都敢动，莫不是不想活了？”
愣了好一会，呵斥的声音才从人群中响起，紧随其后的是钢铁的摩擦声。
两名筑基初期同时爆发出修为，一人手持长剑一人手持大锤，指向李长寿。
对此李长寿并不在意，反而是鄙视地看向剩余的三道身影。
“笑话，先前对老夫出手的是你们，张家人还真是无耻。”
李长寿外表虽老，可那雄霸天下的气势，丝毫不比宗门中的金丹老祖弱。
仿佛眼前的敌人对他来说不过是蝼蚁，动动手指便可轻松镇压。
“好快的剑，好快的速度，这里到处都是大猩猩，能够在这里清修，实力绝不止那么简单。”
张丰心中盘算，压根看不穿这个老头的修为。
“道友，我张家在执行任务，山洞中的气息正是我们的目标。”
“还请把她交出来，或者是你把她斩了，我们立刻就走。”
“如何？”
张丰收敛杀机，拱手行了一礼。
修仙界弱肉强食，在不清楚对方底细的时候，还是先礼后兵。
旁边两名筑基初期对执事行为感到不爽，可他们有脑子懂得审时度势，明白张丰在忌惮着什么，只好选择闭嘴。
“你们确定？”
李长寿擦了擦手上的剑柄，再度确认。
“没错，那人是苏家的余孽，今天必须死！”
这一声直接点燃了李长寿的怒火，他攥紧拳头，手中的长剑直接丢了出去，灵气汇聚在一起好似一根犀利的钢针。
咻咻咻！
现场能够清晰地听到空气被切割的声音。
那名张家弟子感受到一阵窒息，手中的长剑被轻松震碎。
“魔灵盾。”
命悬一线之际，张丰反应极快，一个闪身来到他的面前，凝聚出碧绿屏障，挡住了这一击。
那名张家弟子这才松了口气，同时看向那没有任何裂痕的屏障，眼神变得复杂。
“道友，这么说咱们是谈不拢了？”
张丰的声音逐渐变得阴冷，嘴角更是扬起。
经过这一击的试探，张丰大约已经知道了对方的实力。
那赫然就是筑基中期的力量。
先前看不透他的修为，必然是对方拥有防止窥视的宝贝，这次可赚大了。
“谈个屁，当着老夫的面要杀我的妻子，你们已有取死之道！”
“夫君，你没事吧！”苏千凡身着红衣，担忧地从洞中走出，来到他的身边。
李长寿抓住她的手，脸上的愤怒缓和了几分。
“几个杂碎，为夫抬手可灭，只是让夫人担心了。”
看着周围人首分离的几个张家暗卫，以及李长寿那温柔的眼神，苏千凡心头一颤，顿时感觉心里暖暖的。
“桀桀桀，这小娘皮果然在你这里。”
“同穿红袍，你们定是同党，与其让你们做一对苦命鸳鸯。”
“本执事更想当着你的面欺辱你的女人，让你跪在地上求饶，痛不欲生。”
三人看到出现的苏千凡，同时发出桀桀桀的坏笑声。
“你们先去抓了那苏家的余孽，这老头交给我。”
在张丰的号令下，两名张家弟子宛如恶狼般冲了出去。
苏千凡银牙紧咬，丝毫不虚，在练气的时候就能够在他们的围攻下逃脱数日。
如今她已经是筑基中期的强者，对付两个筑基初期，不过是降维打击。
content_en:
"You are so outrageous that you even dare to touch members of my Zhang family. Do you not want to live anymore?"
After being stunned for a while, the sound of scolding sounded from the crowd, followed closely by the sound of steel friction.
The two early stage foundation builders burst out with cultivation at the same time. One held a long sword and the other held a sledgehammer, pointing at Li Changshou.
Li Changshou didn't care about this, but looked at the remaining three figures with contempt.
"It's a joke. It was you who attacked me earlier. The Zhang family is really shameless."
Although Li Changshou looks old, his world-dominating aura is no weaker than that of the ancestor of the sect's Golden Pill.
It was as if the enemies in front of him were nothing more than ants, and he could easily suppress them with the movement of his fingers.
"What a fast sword, what a speed. There are gorillas everywhere here. To be able to clean up here, one's strength is beyond that simple."
Zhang Feng calculated in his mind that he couldn't see through this old man's cultivation.
"Fellow Taoist, my Zhang family is on a mission, and the breath in the cave is our target."
"Please hand her over, or behead her, and we'll leave immediately."
"How?"
Zhang Feng restrained his murderous intent and bowed his hands.
In the world of cultivating immortals, the weak are the strongest, so when you don't know the details of the other party, you should be polite before attacking.
The two people next to him who were in the early stage of foundation building were unhappy with the deacon's behavior, but they had the brains to assess the situation and understood what Zhang Feng was worried about, so they had no choice but to shut up.
"Are you sure?"
Li Changshou wiped the hilt of the sword on his hand and confirmed again.
"Yes, that person is a remnant of the Su family and must die today!"
This sound directly ignited Li Changshou's anger. He clenched his fists and threw the long sword in his hand directly. The spiritual energy gathered together like a sharp steel needle.
Whoosh!
The sound of air being cut could be clearly heard at the scene.
"What?!"
The Zhang family disciple felt suffocated, and the long sword in his hand was easily shattered.
"Demon Spirit Shield."
When his life was hanging by a thread, Zhang Feng reacted very quickly and ducked in front of him, condensing a green barrier to block the blow.
The Zhang family disciple breathed a sigh of relief, and at the same time looked at the barrier without any cracks, his eyes became complicated.
"Fellow Taoist, does that mean we can't reach an agreement?"
Zhang Feng's voice gradually became colder, and the corners of his mouth raised even more.
After testing this attack, Zhang Feng probably already knew the opponent's strength.
That is clearly the power of the middle stage of foundation building.
If you couldn't see through his cultivation before, it must be because the other party has a treasure to prevent prying eyes. This time, you can make a lot of money.
"That's nonsense. You want to kill my wife in front of me. You already have a way to kill me!"
"Husband, are you okay?" Su Qianfan, dressed in red, walked out of the cave worriedly and came to his side.
Li Changshou grabbed her hand, and the anger on his face softened a bit.
"A few bastards can be killed by my husband, but they only make my wife worried."
Seeing the Zhang family's secret guards with their heads separated around them, and Li Changshou's gentle eyes, Su Qianfan's heart trembled, and he suddenly felt warm in his heart.
"Jie Jie Jie, this little girl is indeed here with you."
"Wearing red robes together, you must be in the same party. I don't want you to be a pair of miserable mandarin ducks."
"This deacon even wants to humiliate your woman in front of you, making you kneel on the ground and beg for mercy, and you will be in pain."
When the three of them saw Su Qianfan appearing, they all let out wicked laughter.
"You go and capture the remnants of the Su family first, and leave this old man to me."
Under Zhang Feng's order, the two Zhang family disciples rushed out like wolves.
Su Qianfan gritted his teeth tightly, showing no signs of weakness. He was able to escape from their siege for several days while practicing Qi.
Now she is already a strong player in the middle stage of foundation building, and dealing with the two early stage foundation establishments is nothing more than a dimension-reducing blow.
